question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Alive
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Alive"** means living, not dead, or having life. (जीवित)

 
 
• **Example:** The plant is still **alive** despite the harsh conditions.
 
 
 
• **"Dead"** refers to no longer alive; having ceased living. (मृत)
 
 
• **Example:** The fish was found **dead** in the aquarium.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Alive'** is **'Dead'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spry** (फुर्तीला): Active and lively, especially in an older person.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his age, he remains** spry** and full of energy.
 
 
 
• **Wise** (बुद्धिमान): Having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment.
 
 
• **Example:** She is **wise** beyond her years.
 
 
 
• **Animated** (उत्साहित): Full of life or excitement; lively.
 
 
• **Example:** The** animated** discussion kept everyone engaged.
